title: Interlacing payload
summary: JSON Schema for the interlacing payload - interlaced flag, field order, telecine-like flag, combed share, field-order costs, ffprobe field_order and idet counts.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_interlacing; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
